questions.q: According to Eli Goldratt's Theory of Constraints, what is the current limiting factor?
questions.why: Overview: the limiting factor has shifted from land to capital to knowledge to creativity.

questions.q: Since 2000, how has world population growth compared to job supply growth?
a: Population grew 2.4 times faster than job supply
Population grew 2.4 times slower than job supply
Job supply grew 2.4 times faster than population
Both grew at the same rate
questions.why: Overview: population has grown 2.4 times faster than the supply of available jobs since 2000.

questions.q: What strategy that worked for baby boomers is now considered useless?
a: Getting a degree to secure a safe job
Starting a business in their twenties
questions.why: Overview: the degree-to-safe-job strategy that worked for baby boomers is now useless.

questions.q: Why have college degrees become less valuable?
a: Too many people now have them
questions.why: Overview: degrees lost value due to the sheer amount of people who have them.
